introduction: 在八十年代藏区旺堆乡，13岁的仁青在“生殖与发育”课上知晓了生命起源于一颗精子和一颗卵子的结合。他陷入身份的迷惘——他的家庭遵循古老的一妻多夫制，母亲卓玛与三位丈夫共同生活。仁青认定每个孩子只能有一个父亲，他开始探问憨厚的阿爸占堆、严厉管教的二叔土登，甚至给他买运动鞋的三叔洛桑，谁才是他的生身父亲？Set in 1980s rural Tibet, thirteen-year-old Renqing discovers in biology class that every child comes from one sperm and one egg — meaning every child has exactly one biological father. The revelation unsettles him: his family follows the ancient practice of fraternal polyandry, with his mother Zhuoma sharing her life with three brothers as husbands. Desperate for a definitive answer, Renqing turns one by one to each of the three men who might be his father — the warm, simple-hearted Zhandui; the stern second uncle Tudeng; and his worldly youngest uncle Losang, who once sent him a pair of brand-new sneakers from the city — but which of them is truly his father?
